title: Executable Written To A Temporary Path And Then Executed
detection_hypothesis: If tooling is staged and then run, a file creation record and a process creation record will reference the identical path on the same host in quick succession.

field_semantics.Computer: Host on which the event was produced.
field_semantics.Image: Absolute path of the executable backing the created process.
field_semantics.TargetFilename: Absolute path of the file that was created or modified.

collection_prerequisites: A process creation source is enabled (Sysmon Event ID 1 or Security Event ID 4688).
Command-line auditing is enabled when Security 4688 is the only available source.
File creation auditing is enabled (Sysmon Event ID 11 or equivalent).
User-writable directories are not globally excluded from collection.
expected_collection_gaps: Aggressive exclusion lists commonly remove temporary directories.
File modification without creation may not raise an event.
Security 4688 without command-line auditing provides no CommandLine value.
Short-lived processes may be lost if the agent is restarted during collection.
normalization_assumptions: CommandLine retains the original argument order and spacing.
Image and ParentImage are absolute paths using backslash separators.
TargetFilename is an absolute path including the file extension.
ingestion_differences: Some agents report short paths or device paths instead of drive letters.
Some pipelines lowercase paths; the lab matcher is case-insensitive by default.
Sysmon and 4688 differ in parent process fidelity and in User field formatting.
retention_considerations: File creation telemetry is high volume; 30 days of hot retention is typical. Process creation is high volume; 30 to 90 days of hot retention is typical.
expected_volume: Low to moderate depending on installer activity.
false_positive_strategy: Installers and build pipelines dominate. Tune on the writing process image and on the host role, and treat matches on user endpoints with no installer parent as the interesting population.
tuning_guidance: Filter the file creation base rule by writing process rather than shortening the timespan, because shortening the window only hides slower staging.
test_strategy: Positive sequences write and then execute the same path on one host. Negative sequences reverse the order, use different paths, and exceed the window.
